projects.title: ERP Data Infrastructure & Medallion Data Warehouse Migration
projects.shortDescription: Migrated a 7-year legacy ERP EAV database to a Medallion Data Warehouse (Bronze-Silver-Gold) via MySQL CDC binlogs & RabbitMQ.
projects.description: Architected and executed the end-to-end migration of a 7-year-old legacy ERP database, transitioning from a complex Entity-Attribute-Value (EAV) model to a centralized Medallion Data Warehouse (Bronze-Silver-Gold) to unlock high-speed analytical reporting, decouple OLTP from OLAP workloads, and eliminate query bottlenecks.
keyImpacts: Reduced analytical query times by over 70%
96% reconciliation rate with zero data loss
responsibilities: Led the overall system architecture, data modeling, migration roadmap, and risk management for mission-critical enterprise financial and advertising data.
Formulated the 3-layer Medallion Data Architecture (Bronze raw binlogs -> Silver cleaned CDC events -> Gold business data marts).
Engineered high-throughput, low-latency microservices in Golang with clean layered architecture and strict schema validation.
Guided 6 cross-functional engineers through sprint planning, automated testing, and zero-downtime cutover.

challengesSolutions.challenge: Modifying the 7-year-old legacy ERP source code to emit events was too risky and slow.
challengesSolutions.solution: Bypassed application code entirely by implementing Change Data Capture (CDC) streaming directly from MySQL Binlogs into RabbitMQ queues.

challengesSolutions.challenge: Distributed network retries risked duplicate or out-of-order writes during data transfer.
challengesSolutions.solution: Built idempotent Go workers consuming RabbitMQ queues enforcing exactly-once semantics with PostgreSQL UPSERT (ON CONFLICT) and distributed deduplication keys.

challengesSolutions.challenge: High ingestion volume caused database I/O contention and processing lag.
challengesSolutions.solution: Horizontally scaled containerized Go workers on Docker, tuned RabbitMQ prefetch limits, and partitioned PostgreSQL Gold tables.

achievements: Achieved a 96% data reconciliation rate between legacy source and target warehouse with zero data loss.
Reduced complex analytical query execution time by over 70% by eliminating multi-level EAV table joins in favor of structured data marts.
Maintained near real-time CDC synchronization with pipeline latency under 2 seconds, ensuring 100% compliance with data privacy regulations (Decree 13/2023/ND-CP).
highlights: Bypassed slow-to-modify legacy ERP source code by implementing Change Data Capture (CDC) reading directly from MySQL binlogs, completely decoupling extraction.
Built idempotent Go workers consuming RabbitMQ queues enforcing exactly-once processing with PostgreSQL UPSERTs (On Conflict).
Achieved 96% data reconciliation rate with zero data loss and reduced query times by >70%.

projects.title: Omnichannel MarTech Hub & Conversion Funnel Analytics
projects.shortDescription: Real-time e-commerce conversion tracking and automated marketing ETL data marts with reactive streaming & automated PII masking.
projects.description: Engineered a centralized Marketing Technology (MarTech) hub to aggregate cross-platform advertising metrics (Google, Facebook, TikTok) and process high-volume e-commerce conversion funnels in real time with automated PII masking and instant BI reporting.
keyImpacts: Sub-second latency for thousands of daily funnel events
100% PII privacy compliance via Spring AOP
Reduced daily report generation time by >40%
responsibilities: Architected non-blocking event-driven API gateway using Java 17, Spring Boot, and Spring WebFlux for conversion telemetry ingestion.
Designed automated PII detection, encryption, and anonymization pipelines using Spring AOP before forwarding metrics to GA4/BigQuery.
Engineered resilient integration adapters for Google Ads, Facebook Graph, and TikTok Marketing APIs with rate limiting and circuit breakers.
Built automated Spring Batch ETL jobs transforming Google BigQuery Avro exports into PostgreSQL reporting tables.

challengesSolutions.challenge: Flash sale campaigns created sudden conversion event spikes that threatened to degrade core booking APIs.
challengesSolutions.solution: Implemented asynchronous, non-blocking ingestion using Spring WebFlux and Apache Kafka buffering, isolating event ingestion from synchronous checkout flows.

challengesSolutions.challenge: Frequent rate limiting and intermittent timeouts from external ad platform APIs (Google/Meta/TikTok).
challengesSolutions.solution: Applied Resilience4j with Circuit Breaker, exponential backoff retries, and token-bucket rate limiters.

challengesSolutions.challenge: Ensuring sensitive user phone numbers and emails never leak into external analytical tools.
challengesSolutions.solution: Created centralized Spring AOP interceptors dynamically detecting, hashing, and masking PII payload fields before data transit.

achievements: Successfully ingested thousands of daily conversion funnel events with sub-second latency without impacting checkout performance.
Achieved 100% PII privacy compliance across all analytics pipelines via automated Spring AOP masking.
Decreased daily cross-channel marketing report generation time by over 40%, enabling immediate campaign ROAS decision-making.
highlights: Developed high-throughput event tracking service using Spring WebFlux and Apache Kafka to capture real-time user journey events.
Engineered secure data gateway using Spring AOP to automatically detect and strip PII before transmitting to Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
Ingested thousands of daily funnel events with sub-second latency and reduced report generation time by >40%.

Redesigned data synchronization flow with batch processing and Redis caching, smoothly handling 1,000 CCU.
Reduced time spent on manual data extraction requests by 40%, significantly improving client satisfaction.
